en: The postcard features a colored image of a small pavilion or spring structure labeled 'Donati-Quelle' (Donati Spring) in a lush park or forested area. A few women in period clothing are visible in the foreground, suggesting a tranquil spa or resort environment. The back contains handwritten correspondence in a Slavic language (most likely Croatian or Slovenian), a purple circular stamp, and an address to Zagreb. The top left of the image reads 'ROHITSCH-SAUERBRUNN,' which is a historical German name.
